description: Plan Your Relaxing Holiday at Amor De Goa by Mirashya Homes! Stay in this cozy 1BHK in the heart of Candolim, featuring a private jacuzzi for the perfect unwind. Enjoy high-speed WiFi, Smart TV, pet-friendly comfort, and stylish interiors. Just minutes from Candolim Beach, popular cafés, restaurants, and nightlife, it's ideal for couples seeking romance, relaxation, and a touch of luxury in North Goa.
